I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store is **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from her own message in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that the morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and that a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he would check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store's login. I couldn't find any later message in that channel saying whether it was fixed, and I told her so.

I only looked at channels Pree is a member of and at public files.
